plan.title: Validation Plan for CR-003 Credit Limit Assignment Strategy

checks.title: AUC on Test Set
checks.rationale: AUC measures the model's ability to discriminate between positive and negative cases.

checks.title: AUC on Out-of-Time Sample
checks.rationale: AUC on OOT ensures the model maintains performance over time.

checks.title: Calibration Ratio
checks.rationale: Calibration ratio assesses the alignment of predicted probabilities with observed outcomes.

checks.title: Population Stability Index (PSI) from Train to OOT
checks.rationale: PSI indicates how much the distribution of scores has changed over time.

checks.title: Missing Any Rate
checks.rationale: High missing rates can indicate data quality issues that affect model performance.

checks.title: Adverse Decision Rate
checks.rationale: Monitoring adverse decision rates ensures compliance with lending policies.

checks.title: Disparate Impact Ratio
checks.rationale: Disparate impact ratio assesses fairness across different demographic groups.

checks.title: Monotonicity Check by PD Band
checks.rationale: Monotonicity ensures that higher PD bands do not receive higher limits.

plan.rationale: This validation plan focuses on performance, calibration, stability, fairness, data quality, and policy compliance for the CR-003 model.

data.summary: The validation plan for CR-003 includes checks for performance metrics like AUC and PSI, ensuring model stability and fairness across demographic groups. It also addresses data quality and policy compliance, with thresholds reflecting industry standards.
